name: @pipeup/agents
description: Lets an AI agent read and answer a page's comments: its replies file, the live link on this computer (pipeup watch or the shell link) and the prompt for an agent.
author: Pipeup contributors

to: the replies file next to this page (this site or this computer)
a link running on this computer (pipeup watch, or the shell link), only after you switch on Share with my agent
network.says: Reads a replies file next to this page, and replies you paste from your agent. When a link is running on this computer, and only after you switch it on, it sends this page's comments to that link. Nothing leaves this computer.
